git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(hook): name the pending-dispatch remedy on block/warn, signal FIFO ambiguity (H1)

Review finding H1 (full-branch review, m-2026-09-08-004 round 3): a spawn
that matched a pending dispatch but whose mission contract failed to
load, or was no longer open, was blocked/warned with the generic
MISSION_ID-environment-variable wording -- even though the actual source
was a clearable sidecar file. dispatchTierB already carried boundVia;
missionResolutionFailedMessage and warnNonOpenMission now switch on it to
name the session, the worker, the mission, and `ethos mission release`
(or the narrower `ethos mission close`/`abandon <id>`) as the remedy.
warnNonOpenMissionID's doc comment, which claimed no caller ever named a
clearable sidecar, is corrected -- round 3 added exactly that caller.

Also adds the FIFO ambiguity signal requested separately: when two or
more live pending dispatches match a spawn's worker, matchDispatchPending
still resolves to the oldest (FIFO unchanged) but now names the
ambiguity on stderr -- the count, the worker, every competing mission ID,
which one was chosen, and that MISSION_ID overrides the match. Fires only
on a genuine same-worker tie; a session with pending dispatches for two
different workers stays quiet for either one's spawn.

Regression tests confirmed failing against pre-fix code via git-stash
falsification.
EOF
)"
